source: Android could not find a file picker. Enable the Files or Documents app in Android settings, then try again.
unchanged_han: Android 尋毋著檔案揀器。請在 Android 設定肚啟用「Files」抑係「文件」程式，過試看。
before: Android chhìm m̀ cho̍k tóng-on kién-hi. Chhiáng chhai Android sat-thin tú khí-yung “Files” ia-he “vùn-khien” chhàng-sṳt, ko chhṳ khon.
accepted_pfs: Android chhìm m̀ tó tóng-on kién-hi. Chhiáng chhai Android sat-thin tú khí-yung “Files” ya-he “vùn-khien” chhàng-sṳt, ko chhṳ khon.
scope: Exact one inherited warning in hak-Latn-TW; complete warning reviewed against source, Han counterpart and both call sites. No other locale keys changed.

change_classification.classification: directly attested PFS orthographic alignment, not a claim that every initial-ia spelling is invalid

meaning_review.trigger: ClassicPaintActivity.launchPicker handles ActivityNotFoundException, including failure of ACTION_GET_CONTENT fallback after ACTION_OPEN_DOCUMENT; LegacyImageCreditsActivity uses the warning on ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT ActivityNotFoundException. SecurityException has a distinct warning.
meaning_review.failure: Android cannot locate a file picker. No mistaken statement that a file was lost, denied, or unreadable.
meaning_review.recovery: Enable Files or Documents in Android settings, then retry. Alternative apps, Android target, enabling action and retry are all retained.
meaning_review.labels: Android and Files are preserved; vùn-khien is the same Documents label as 文件 in the unchanged Han counterpart.
meaning_review.register: Polite software instruction using Chhiáng. No new account, installation or deletion instruction.

term_review.reason: failed-finding result complement, not the correct/incorrect reading cog5
retained computing noun plus choose/tool; compound matches file picker, without changing picker type
polite instruction; cai entry explicitly permits locative preposition
settings plus inside; 設定 is retained technical wording, with component readings supported
enable/begin using; retained technical wording; 啟 supports opening/beginning, 用 supported in 採用
or; the pronunciation is unchanged, while ya-he aligns the Latin spelling with directly attested PFS usage
retains the Han counterpart’s localized Documents label, and Files remains literal
retains program/app computing term; component readings supported
try again; dictionary explicitly supports go55 in the sense again and cii kon for try

orthography_note: MOE uses the official Hakka romanization, not PFS. PFS renderings apply the target orthographic convention; do31 maps to tó (unaspirated t; shang acute). Comparison of the complete sentence is linguistic reasoning, not a mechanical character substitution or dictionary certification of the whole UI message.
review_status: Author and independent reviewer accept the same complete final sentence; exact receipt in independent-review.json.
limits: AI author and independent AI reviewer, not native-speaker certification.
The remaining catalogues, earlier withdrawn review claims, PR85 new key and processing holds are outside this patch.
No Android build, install, screenshot, or device-level verification by this worker.
Primary dictionary data supports individual words/components; computing compounds and full sentence are contextual translation judgments.
Direct fetch of the NYCU PFS research PDF returned 502 and web cache misses, so that full PDF is not claimed as read by this author.
validation_base_note: The first full host suite was interrupted after the parent reported a newly merged develop commit; the minimal patch was applied with git apply --check to the complete supplied new-source snapshot. No result from the interrupted older-baseline host run is counted.

primary_pfs_usage.retrieval: Web tool successfully opened the public corpus index; separate urllib request returned HTTP 403 and was not retried.
primary_pfs_usage.application: Direct target-orthography usage supports the complement spelling and conjunction; word grouping around m̀ does not change meaning.
